title: Shipping a Personal Site That Feels Instant
author: SOM_WHY
summary: My site was fast on localhost and unusable the moment it hit the internet. Four bottlenecks, four fixes, and a 19 MB deploy cut down to under 12 MB.
title_zh: 让个人站点「秒开」的那些坑
summary_zh: 本地飞快、上线即卡。四个瓶颈、四处改动，把 19 MB 的部署产物压到 12 MB 以内。

title: Where Should Player State Live?
author: SOM_WHY
summary: A music player looks like local UI state until you notice the audio has to survive route changes. Notes on keeping playback, progress and the DOM node in the right places.
title_zh: 播放器状态该放在哪一层
summary_zh: 音乐播放器看起来是局部 UI 状态，直到你发现音频必须跨路由存活。关于播放、进度与 DOM 节点各该放在哪一层的笔记。
